outcome: Comorbidities (PH, congestive heart failure, coronary artery disease)
Adverse delivery events (heart failure, arrhythmias, thromboembolic events, pre-eclampsia, placenta previa)
cohort: 22,881,691 deliveries in the United States from 2008 to 2013, identified from the National Inpatient Sample.
finding: Pregnant women with CHDs were more likely to have comorbidities (PH, congestive heart failure, coronary artery disease) and experience adverse events during delivery (heart failure, arrhythmias, thromboembolic events).
mod_finding: Cesarean section, induction, and operative vaginal delivery were more common in women with CHDs, whereas fetal distress was less common.
